answers.core: Again, I'm not sure if an add-on is capable of that. It changes how saving behaves, so it probably should be implemented in the engine itself.
answers.workaround:
Definitely not a few. It may be possible to write an editor plugin that does this, though I'm not sure. I don't know if add-ons can hook into the scene saving process and change how it behaves.

Alternatively you can set the animation to RESET each time you save, but that's very annoying.

title: Don't save animated property values to scene files
